response.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(Bytes * 1.0 / Milliseconds) AS avg_bpms FROM Track WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds <> 0 GROUP BY AlbumId) SELECT AlbumId, avg_unit_price, avg_bpms, avg_bpms - (SELECT AVG(avg_bpms) FROM a) AS diff_from_average FROM a ORDER BY diff_from_average DESC LIMIT 10
